title: 記憶體控制器與 ECC

summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect dram timing, scheduling and diagnosable correction through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 地址與 DRAM 組織
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「地址與 DRAM 組織」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop addressing and dram organization through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 地址解碼：原理與架構

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「地址解碼」的資料、控制與時間關係。位址映射至通道、rank、bank 與列。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想位元欄位填入地址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for address decoding. Addresses map to channel, rank, bank and row. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Fill assumed address bit fields. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 將假想位元欄位填入地址。

steps.check: 提交「地址解碼」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「位址映射至通道、rank、bank 與列。」。

steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for evidence scope using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「證據範圍」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。 核對「無錯誤紀錄可能代表未啟用報告。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for evidence scope and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check monitoring coverage, not zeros alone. Check the principle: No error logs may mean reporting is disabled. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。
steps.observationEn: Check monitoring coverage, not zeros alone.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：6400 MT/s 代表每秒 6400 百萬完整記憶體命令。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: 6400 MT/s means 6400 million full memory commands per second. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「證據範圍」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence scope input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 證據範圍的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 無錯誤紀錄可能代表未啟用報告。
knowledge.textEn: No error logs may mean reporting is disabled.

knowledge.title: 證據範圍的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Check monitoring coverage, not zeros alone. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設單通道 64-bit 資料匯流排、6400 MT/s：資料峰值=8 B×6.4×10⁹/s=51.2 GB/s，未含 refresh 與排程。假想 64-bit 資料加 8-bit ECC，儲存額外=8/64=12.5%；不是所有 DIMM 編碼。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 64-bit channel at 6400 MT/s has 51.2 GB/s payload peak, excluding refresh and scheduling. A hypothetical 64+8 ECC word has 12.5% storage overhead; not all DIMMs use this code.

quiz.question: 本步審查「證據範圍」與整體「記憶體控制器與 ECC」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing evidence scope within memory controllers and ecc, which statement or check is supported?
options: ECC 可更正任何位元數的錯誤。

optionsEn: ECC corrects arbitrarily many bit errors.

quiz.explanation: 無錯誤紀錄可能代表未啟用報告。 檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: No error logs may mean reporting is disabled. Check monitoring coverage, not zeros alone. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假設單通道 64-bit 資料匯流排、6400 MT/s：資料峰值=8 B×6.4×10⁹/s=51.2 GB/s，未含 refresh 與排程。假想 64-bit 資料加 8-bit ECC，儲存額外=8/64=12.5%；不是所有 DIMM 編碼。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 64-bit channel at 6400 MT/s has 51.2 GB/s payload peak, excluding refresh and scheduling. A hypothetical 64+8 ECC word has 12.5% storage overhead; not all DIMMs use this code.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.
